name: Zeph
source:
One of the major crime bosses of the Nox Syndicate, and one of its oldest members.
Know for his brutality and ambition, Zeph has gained a reputation among his compatriots as a man that should not be crossed. Upon the death of Boss Hevlan, he became one of the obvious choices to be his replacement.
